# Karthik Vinod
> Official portfolio website of Karthik Vinod, Full-Stack Developer & Software Engineer.

## About
Karthik Vinod is a Full-Stack Developer and Software Engineer specializing in end-to-end scalable web applications, backend microservices, AI-powered tools, and high-performance interactive interfaces. Available worldwide for remote roles, consulting, and engineering collaboration.

## Core Technologies
- Frontend: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Zustand
- Backend & Cloud: Node.js, Python, REST APIs, SQL & NoSQL, Firebase, Git & GitHub

## Featured Projects
- **LifeMastery**: An all-in-one AI-powered productivity and personal growth application (React.js, Tailwind CSS, Firebase, PWA).
- **Glint AI Headshots**: AI headshot generator transforming selfies into studio-quality portraits (React.js, TypeScript, Cloudinary, Tailwind CSS).
- **Karthik's OS Portfolio**: Device-adaptive portfolio inspired by macOS on desktop and iOS on mobile (React.js, GSAP, Zustand).
